chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd, from Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabīb al-Zayyāt, who said:

The one who had been seated in the presence of Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام informed me that when they arose, he عليه السلام said to them: “Meet Abū Jaʿfar, then greet him عليه السلام and renew acquaintance with him.”
Then when the people rose, he turned toward me and said: “May Allah have mercy upon al-Mufaḍḍal; he used to be content with less than this.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the person whom the Imam directed the people to meet and greet
key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا: Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the Imam in whose gathering this statement was made
key_terms.الْمُفَضَّلَ: al-Mufaḍḍal, the individual mentioned by the Imam with mercy
key_terms.عَهْدًا: renewed connection, acquaintance, or covenantal familiarity
key_terms.فَسَلِّمُوا: offer salām; greet with peace and recognition
key_terms.يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ: may Allah show mercy; a supplicatory expression

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام indicate the status of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام to his companions?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an indication by Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام toward Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, instructing those present to go to him, greet him, and renew their connection with him. It reflects recognition of Abū Jaʿfar’s authority and preserves a moment of designation within the history of the Imams عليهم السلام.
